name: Enemies under the Bridge: Kharadol Ealdir's Frost Arrow slows the player by 30% (COA-9557)
contract: Kharadol Ealdir 164317 casts Frost Arrow 365154 at the player in the Gilded Vale. Its tooltip says it slows movement speed; its SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED effect now carries -30, so a struck player runs at 70% speed while the debuff lasts.
